sources.beginner: Suite FDP Accelerator (src/pages/apps/FDPAccelerator.jsx): scenario cards in src/components/fdp/modules/scenarios/ScenarioManager.jsx (NPV toFixed(1), IRR 'n/a' on multiple roots), roots only in the plan economics card src/components/fdp/modules/cost/EconomicsAnalysis.jsx:41-62 via src/utils/fdp/planEconomics.js:181 irrReason; reserves src/components/fdp/modules/subsurface/ReservesTable.jsx:146; sums are also hand-calc from the prompt. NextGen panels are EGINA-only (panelCapstoneGuard.test.js).
sources.intermediate: Suite FDP Accelerator: schedule CriticalPath.jsx:46/53 (integers), wells WellForm.jsx:178 days (integer) with cost printed only as $M toFixed(1) (WellForm.jsx:182, WellInventory.jsx:50), facilities FacilitiesCostEstimation.jsx:19/34 toFixed(1) $M. Well cost = days x rig x 2.5 is taught in intermediate/m03/l02.
sources.advanced: EV and completion ratio are hand-calc as taught in advanced/m04/l01; PV and SPI need the as-of date 2030-03-31, but Project Management Pro pins the as-of to the machine clock (src/pages/apps/ProjectManagementPro.jsx:26,111) and prints SPI toFixed(2) (src/components/projectmanagement/SnapshotCard.jsx:88); UKOT NPV items from FDP Accelerator ScenarioManager.jsx:144 and the tornado src/components/fdp/modules/cost/SensitivityAnalysis.jsx (Recharts Tooltip, no formatter).

fields.evidence: Card prints `${npv.toFixed(1)}M` = 1694.1, |1694.1-1694.0732| = 0.027 <= tol 0.05; tol equals half a unit of the printed place.
fields.notes: Prompt asks four decimals but the app prints one; tol 0.05 absorbs the one-decimal display, so a learner is not failed. EconomicsAnalysis.jsx:51 prints the same toFixed(1).

fields.recommendation: Display fix (prompt explicitly asks four decimals). Fallback if the app cannot change: tol 0.01 -> 0.05 (half a unit of the one printed decimal).
fields.evidence: CONFIRMED: irrReason maps roots with `${r.toFixed(1)}%`, so the card reads 'the NPV is zero at -43.2% and ...'; |-43.2 - (-43.2259)| = 0.0259 > tol 0.01, so a learner who copies the only printed value fails. The scenario card (ScenarioManager.jsx:150) shows only 'n/a' on multiple roots.
fields.notes: Not hand-calc at Associate tier: no beginner lesson teaches root-finding on the cash flow (lessons only say status multiple-roots). The NextGen ValueExplorer prints roots to four decimals (ValueExplorer.jsx:108) but for EGINA only.

fix.display: src/pages/apps/ProjectManagementPro.jsx:111 -> add an as-of date input (default today) and pass it to calculateEVM({ asOf }) instead of todayIsoDate(); show PV on the snapshot card to whole USD

fields.recommendation: Display fix (an as-of input). Without it the prompt's 2030-03-31 cannot be set; the app measures to today (2026), before every planned window, so PV reads 0. Hand-calc is not a safe fallback: the day-count convention is not taught and inclusive vs exclusive days moves PV by 16000-30000 USD against tol 1.
fields.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 2 decimals (jest: fdp/__tests__/w3FullPrecision.test.jsx, calculateEVM at 2030-03-31 through formatFull, checked against the key first).
fields.notes: The course itself (m04/l05) says the as-of date is 'a parameter, not a clock', which the Suite app contradicts.
